components.name: Persistent modeling subsystem
components.responsibility: Expose provider-free revisioned modeling and read-only document export.
components.rationale: Logical root groups the external-Agent explanation lifecycle, not a separate runtime orchestrator.

claim.explanation: Logical root groups the external-Agent explanation lifecycle, not a separate runtime orchestrator.
assumptions: These are Agent-authored logical boundaries, not extracted ownership.

components.name: JSON command boundary
components.responsibility: Parse commands, select model operations and return structured JSON outcomes.
components.rationale: Both export and apply enter run; command dispatch is distinct from domain rules and persistence.

claim.explanation: Both export and apply enter run; command dispatch is distinct from domain rules and persistence.
assumptions: These are Agent-authored logical boundaries, not extracted ownership.

components.name: Revisioned model store
components.responsibility: Read validated models, build patch candidates and atomically commit a revision under a lock.
components.rationale: Shared read and mutation lifecycle belongs to one logical service; model_diff is an impact calculation, not semantic source truth.

claim.explanation: Shared read and mutation lifecycle belongs to one logical service; model_diff is an impact calculation, not semantic source truth.
assumptions: These are Agent-authored logical boundaries, not extracted ownership.

components.name: Structural and evidence invariants
components.responsibility: Reject invalid schema, identities, evidence references, hierarchy and revision history.
components.rationale: A cross-cutting rule boundary shared by read, patch and export; it does not judge business truth.

claim.explanation: A cross-cutting rule boundary shared by read, patch and export; it does not judge business truth.
assumptions: These are Agent-authored logical boundaries, not extracted ownership.

components.name: Version-specific source review
components.responsibility: Compare saved evidence, project affected interpretations and retain explicit rebind/review history.
components.rationale: maintenance.py and maintenance_coverage.py form one review responsibility spanning files; binding currency and explanation coverage stay distinct.

claim.explanation: maintenance.py and maintenance_coverage.py form one review responsibility spanning files; binding currency and explanation coverage stay distinct.
assumptions: These are Agent-authored logical boundaries, not extracted ownership.

components.name: Offline document projection
components.responsibility: Freeze a validated model, attach maintenance views and hash-checked source snippets, and publish standalone HTML.
components.rationale: Document assembly is a consumer of the model; browser interaction is outside this Python-only extraction.

claim.explanation: Document assembly is a consumer of the model; browser interaction is outside this Python-only extraction.
assumptions: These are Agent-authored logical boundaries, not extracted ownership.

components.name: Native facts boundary
components.responsibility: Export an immutable Python evidence catalog using a bounded native worker and explicit tools.
components.rationale: Separates real static extraction from authored explanation; native analyzer implementation is beyond this model.

claim.explanation: Separates real static extraction from authored explanation; native analyzer implementation is beyond this model.
assumptions: These are Agent-authored logical boundaries, not extracted ownership.

scenarios.name: Read a persistent model and export interactive HTML

claim.explanation: run selects export-html; model file and source root are explicit inputs.
ModelStore.read loads JSON and validates the complete model before export; read_scope is not this path.
export_html calls projection, which validates a copy of the same model rather than reading another revision.
query derives maintenance contexts and pending coverage; it does not refresh facts or save the model.
_snippet resolves evidence paths within source root and embeds text only for matching containing-file bytes; unavailable bodies retain locations.
export_html embeds assets and escaped JSON, fsyncs a temporary file and publishes via non-overwriting os.link; failures raise EXPORT_FAILED.
main returns JSON containing output, model ID and revision; output delivery can fail independently of operation completion.
